newsitem.title: UK: UK plans new onshore oil/gas licence round soon.
newsitem.headline: UK plans new onshore oil/gas licence round soon.

text.p: Britain will open an eighth onshore licensing round for oil and gas exploration "shortly", junior energy minister Richard Page said on Monday in a written parliamentary answer.
He said the decision to launch the new round, which follows one in March last year, was partly in response to a growing interest in the industry in using methane venting from disused coal mines.
But applications for the exploration of conventional oil and natural gas resources would also be invited.
Page said in a written parliamentary answer that a formal notice will be issued soon and the closing date for applications will be 90 days after it is published.
